questions.text_verbatim: (a) Enumerate the three main principles of LLMC (Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims) convention 1976 and explain its linkage with two other IMO Liability and compensation Conventions. (5) (b) Discuss what are the different liabilities covered under the LLMC (Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims) Convention 1976. (5) (c) Discuss the principles of the International Salvage Convention 1989, as established by the IMO, Furthermore, examine the rationale for extending liability limitation to salvors under the LLMC Convention, and specify the current liability limit applicable to them. (6)

subparts.text: Enumerate the three main principles of the LLMC Convention 1976 and explain its linkage with two other IMO liability and compensation conventions.
The different liabilities covered under the LLMC Convention 1976.
The principles of the International Salvage Convention 1989; the rationale for extending liability limitation to salvors under the LLMC Convention; and the current liability limit applicable to them.
